Set up Slack

  1. Open the link below to create the MMHotline app in your Slack workspace. The link includes the app manifest. Create the Slack app

  2. Install the MMHotline app to your workspace. Copy the MMHotline app's Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-).

  3. Under Basic Information, generate an app-level token (xapp-) with connections:write and copy the app-level token.

  4. Put the bot token and app-level token in the settings file, as shown below, and apply the settings file. MMHotline checks the tokens with Slack before saving the tokens. Then connect Slack under Contact methods.

Settings file keys

  • Slack bot token

    sending_services.slack.bot_token

    Install the MMHotline app and copy the app's Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-).

  • Slack app-level token

    sending_services.slack.app_level_token

    Under Basic Information, generate an app-level token (xapp-) with connections:write.

Example settings

sending_services:
  slack:
    bot_token: <Slack bot token>
    app_level_token: <Slack app-level token>
Where Slack is set up

Set in TEMPORARY-DIRECTORY/mmhotline_settings.yml, in sending_services.slack. The file's first line says: Managed by MMX from mmhotline_settings.yml in the systems repository. Change it there and push; util01 applies it.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
